latencyCaveat: Time to observation of completed reply; includes observation delay, not exact service latency. Source upload time excluded.
sourceSelection: All six sources selected before submission
capture: Copy model response to clipboard via browser UI; serialized transcription matches observed clipboard text length and FNV-1a checksum. UI interaction transcript retains source selection and completed reply evidence.
normalization: response.json adds one trailing LF to raw-response.txt; no semantic edits or citation stripping
comparisonCaveat: Fresh notebook with identical six sources and identical shortened prompt. Backend model and retrieval internals unknown.
